decisions.reason: As a core pipeline component with ongoing website presence and clear strategic fit, this option remains valuable and inexpensive to keep open.
Although outside the core pipeline business, the waste bin leverages existing fabrication and coating capabilities and still holds uncertain but low-cost option value.
The bin with ashtray is a further niche option that costs little to keep and may serve municipal customers, so uncertainty still favors holding.
Outdoor ashtrays are the most peripheral option, but keeping them costs little and the firm can abandon later if demand does not materialize.
